title: AssistedCandidateIntake
description: P98 assisted-mode candidate intake. A human or external tool supplies a candidate invariant / bug hypothesis; Audit-Watch then VALIDATES it with the proven components (depth trace, adversarial ordering, maximal consequence, hygiene, severity gate). RESEARCH-ONLY, advisory, UN-WIRED. The system never auto-submits, never sets production severity, never routes. candidate_invariant is REQUIRED and non-empty: P97 showed the failing step was autonomous invariant SELECTION, so assisted-mode requires the invariant to be supplied.

candidate_invariant.description: REQUIRED, non-empty. The invariant the candidate relies on being TRUE (the property the suspected bug would break). This is the input P97 showed the system cannot reliably pick autonomously.

suspected_break.description: How the invariant is suspected to break (the bug hypothesis)

attacker_or_trigger_actor.description: Who triggers the break (attacker / third party / sequencing)

entrypoint.description: EOA-reachable entrypoint that initiates the path

source_refs.description: Concrete source references (file:line) grounding the claim

expected_impact.description: Expected worst-case impact class wording, e.g. 'High - users under-withdraw'

known_unknowns.description: Open questions / unresolved dependencies the supplier is aware of

requested_check.description: What the supplier wants Audit-Watch to do with the candidate
